title: Listed NCD bought at a premium and redeemed at par: LTCL of Rs 600 set off against s.112A equity LTCG before the Rs 1.25 lakh exemption
covers: listed NCD redemption is a transfer
LTCL set off against s.112A LTCG (s.70(3))
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.2(47)(ii): redemption at maturity extinguishes the rights in the debenture -> transfer; FIFO lot matching
Income-tax Act 1961 s.2(42A) first proviso: listed security (other than a unit) held more than 12 months -> long-term
s.50AA as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024 covers only unlisted bonds/debentures (and market-linked debentures) -> not applicable to a listed NCD
Income-tax Act 1961 s.70(3): a long-term capital loss is set off only against long-term capital gains of the same year, including s.112A gains; set-off is mandatory, not optional

Income-tax Act 1961 s.112A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: 12.5 % on LTCG exceeding Rs 1,25,000; the threshold applies to s.112A LTCG included in total income, i.e. after s.70 set-off (s.74 brought-forward losses would also come before it; none here)
derivation: KILO FINANCE NCD: buy 2023-06-15, 10 @ 1,060.00 -> cost 10,600.00 (clean price; accrued interest ignored).
Redemption 2025-06-15 at par: 10 @ 1,000.00 -> proceeds 10,000.00; held exactly 24 months (> 12, listed) -> long; loss 10,000 - 10,600 = -600.00 (rate bucket 12.5 %).
s.112A threshold: exemption_used 1,25,000.00; taxable 74,400 (same result if the threshold were applied first: 2,00,000 - 1,25,000 - 600 = 74,400).
